Class AbstractPulsarMessageToSpringMessageAdapter<V>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.pulsar.spring.listener.adapter.AbstractPulsarMessageToSpringMessageAdapter<V>
Type Parameters:
V - payload type.
Direct Known Subclasses:
PulsarBatchMessagesToSpringMessageListenerAdapter, PulsarRecordMessageToSpringMessageListenerAdapter, PulsarRecordMessageToSpringMessageReaderAdapter
public abstract class AbstractPulsarMessageToSpringMessageAdapter<V> extends Object
An abstract MessageListener adapter providing the necessary infrastructure to extract the payload from a Pulsar message.

    • setTrustedPackages

      public void setTrustedPackages(String... trustedPackages)
      Add packages to trust for header deserialization. Trust is by exact package match; sub-packages are not trusted transitively. The given packages are added to JsonPulsarHeaderMapper.DEFAULT_TRUSTED_PACKAGES, which are always included. Pass "*" as the sole entry to trust all packages (not recommended when consuming from untrusted sources).
      Parameters:
      trustedPackages - packages to add to the trusted list for header deserialization
